integrity: Analytic inclusion-exclusion and strict product inequalities prove the result for all stated parameters. The independent exact-rational enumerator is a reproducibility check, not a substitute for the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite independently assigned attributes with each probability strictly between zero and one, common to all vertices for that attribute; three specified labels. No claim for vertex-specific membership probabilities, fixed-degree incidence, or higher shared-attribute thresholds. Literature priority remains qualified.
title: Conditional sign reversal in random intersection graph triads
